text: おれたち　ぼうそう　ぞく！
note: 暴走族 (bōsōzoku) are Japan's real motorcycle gangs, a youth subculture known for noisy group rides on modified bikes.
claim: Bōsōzoku (暴走族) is a Japanese youth subculture of motorcycle gangs known for riding modified, noisy bikes in groups.

check.quote: Bōsōzoku (暴走族, lit. 'reckless driving group') is a Japanese youth subculture associated with customized motorcycles. ... making noise by removing the mufflers on their vehicles so that more noise is produced. ... bōsōzoku would often embark on massed rides, in which up to 100 bikers would cruise together slowly en masse down an expressway or major highway.
check.note: 暴走族 (bōsōzoku) are Japan's real motorcycle gangs, a youth subculture known for noisy group rides on modified bikes.
